briefdescription.para: The space and all its indexes are fully built.
The state of memtx recovery process.

detaileddescription.para: There is a global state of the entire engine state of each space. The state of a space is initialized from the engine state when the space is created. The exception is system spaces, which are always created in the final (OK) state.

The states exist to speed up recovery: initial state assumes write-only flow of sorted rows from a snapshot. It's followed by a state for read-write recovery of rows from the write ahead log; these rows are inserted only into the primary key. The final state is for a fully functional space.
